credits: Two super-nice early 60s versions of an age-old spiritual, here given a popcorn R&B feel, with a low tempo still prime for the dance floor, and vocals from some of the best voices in soul and R&B history - Jackie Wilson and Linda Hopkins on the top side, and Big Maybelle on the reverse. Both versions were previously only available on albums, making this handy pairing their 45rpm debut, and a great DJ tool.
